primary_hypothesis: A common final-only consolidation stage converts prior verified-trace learning into better free final answers than equally long final-only training.
restore: full parent model plus AdamW optimizer, torch/python/sampler RNG; no retraining parent
new_schedule: stage2 AdamW LR cosine .0003 to .00006 over1000steps, original betas(.9,.95),wd.01,clip1
sampler: restore original per-parent RNG and same family/prompt-length pools; assert all six continuation minibatch sequences match
train: exact8192 G5S cases; full259vocabulary; completion-only F=<integer>
validation: original400 cases, not used to select checkpoints or hyperparameters
held: 1600 fresh cases:IID400,surface400,extrapolation400,CF400/200pairs; no canonical overlap with all known G5S cases
inference: prompt strings only,greedy128newbytes,no tools,EOS required; parser accepts one terminal F with optional trace for both arms
selection: fixed stage2-step1000 only, no test-based early stopping
compute: stage2 inputs,loss tokens,parameters and updates match; parent trace phase had extra tokens/FLOPs
G7S_difference: G7S is a from-scratch fresh-data registered plan with missing code/data bytes. G8C instead continues available trained G5S CPU weights on original train and separately fresh held. Not a replay of G7S.
scope: small generative mechanism experiment, NOT a new300-800M model,not broad code benchmark,not Qwen comparison
financial_authorization: finite public GitHub CPU CI only, no paid API or billing change
